{"predictors": [
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Stability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of capital expenditures over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with stable capital expenditures are better positioned to weather economic downturns, as they have a more predictable cost structure.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Relative R&D Intensity", "construction": "Calculate R&D expenditures as a percentage of sales for each firm, then rank firms within their industry (defined by 2-digit SIC code) based on this metric, using Compustat and CRSP data.", "rationale": "Firms that invest more heavily in R&D relative to their industry peers are more likely to experience future growth and innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Funding Status", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of pension plan assets to liabilities, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pension plans are less likely to face future cash outflows and associated stock price declines.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Insider Trading Sentiment", "construction": "Calculate the net number of shares purchased by insiders (executives and directors) over the past year, scaled by total shares outstanding, using insider trading data from the SEC.", "rationale": "Insiders with superior knowledge of their firms' prospects are likely to make informed trading decisions, which can predict future stock price movements.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Exposure", "construction": "Calculate a firm's environmental liability exposure based on the number and severity of environmental incidents (e.g., EPA violations) over the past 5 years, using data from the EPA and other sources.", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liability exposure face potential future costs and reputational damage, which can negatively impact their stock price.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Structure", "construction": "Calculate a governance score based on factors such as board independence, executive compensation, and shareholder rights, using proxy statement data.", "rationale": "Firms with strong corporate governance structures are more likely to act in shareholders' interests and make value-enhancing decisions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of supplier concentration for each firm, using data on supplier relationships from industry reports and other sources.", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated supply chains are more vulnerable to supplier disruptions and price increases, which can negatively impact their stock price.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Market Competition", "construction": "Calculate a competition score based on factors such as industry concentration, barriers to entry, and product differentiation, using data from industry reports and other sources.", "rationale": "Firms operating in highly competitive product markets are more likely to experience downward pressure on prices and profits.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Relations", "construction": "Calculate a score based on factors such as unionization rates, employee turnover, and worker safety records, using data from the BLS and other sources.", "rationale": "Firms with positive employee relations are more likely to experience improved productivity and reduced labor costs.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Community Involvement", "construction": "Calculate a score based on factors such as charitable donations, community development programs, and environmental sustainability initiatives, using data from firm reports and other sources.", "rationale": "Firms that demonstrate a commitment to community involvement and social responsibility may experience enhanced reputation and customer loyalty.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
